subject: science
prompt:
## Two surfaces

Touch the inside of your cheek with your tongue: it feels soft and wet. Now look at the shiny surface of a fresh leaf. Both are outer layers that cover what lies beneath them.

**Predict:** Is the lining of your cheek made of the same tissue as the surface of the leaf?

options.text: Yes. Both cover and protect what is beneath them, so both are the same covering tissue.
No. Both cover and protect, but the lining of the cheek is a different tissue from the surface of the leaf.
No. The inside of the cheek has no covering tissue at all; only the skin outside the body has one.
